content: Root cause: The original implementation of the `LineEntityProcessor` did not properly handle the end-of-input condition, leading it to process only the first file when used in conjunction with the `FileListEntityProcessor`. When the end of the input was detected (i.e., `line == null`), the processor failed to close resources and reset the reader appropriately, leading to a resource leak and subsequent failure to properly process additional files. The patch introduced a `closeResources()` method to handle resource cleanup and ensured that the state of the reader was reset after reaching the end of the input, allowing subsequent file processing to occur correctly.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -      if (line == null) return null; // end of input
